_readme: Fourth read for the Cerritos Ironworker ladder (S330). Read 3 (run 37234256967) printed the Schedule+ form (POST /schedule/courses.cgi; Terms 1269 Fall 2026 and 1273 Spring 2027; Depts AED and IWAP among the department boxes) and the Technology division's articulation page, which states the process (a B or better, the Cerritos application, a Credit by Exam form with a college representative) and says the agreements are public at Statewide Career Pathways without linking it. This read submits the Schedule+ form for AED and IWAP in both terms, reads the Statewide Career Pathways site (the ASCCC's SB 70 project, statewidepathways.org, found by web search 2026-10-04; it has served over http only), the Technology Pathways roadmaps page the procedure record names as an open item, and the catalog's Educational Partnerships & Programs page.

outside_hosts.statewidepathways.org: Statewide Career Pathways, the ASCCC's SB 70 school-to-college articulation database where Cerritos says its agreements are published

http_hosts.www.statewidepathways.org: web search returns only http addresses for this site (2026-10-04); the https page is read first

questions.noncredit_aed: Whether the 26 noncredit AED courses run this year (sections in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027).
questions.apprenticeship_hours: The IWAP sections this year, beside the classroom hours already confirmed.
